mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tightening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST above 1050.0) and retail sales (RSAFS above 460,000.0) indicates robust consumer demand that drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1050.0 and RSAFS > 460,000.0 fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative policy supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO above 100.0) indicates strengthening manufacturing output that correlates with corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,050,000 units (HOUST > 1050.0), it signals strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1050.0.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating industrial production (INDPRO above 105.0) indicates manufacturing sector momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.
